correctness.rationale: Using independent area-uniform radial density 2r/R^2 and uniform polar angles, E(D²)=R²[1-(8/9)sinc(theta/2)^2] and E(D⁴)=R⁴[5/3-(32/15)sinc(theta/2)^2+(1/2)sinc(theta)^2]. These follow by expanding (U²+V²-2UVcos delta)^2 with E(U^j)=2/(j+2). The denominator is strictly positive. Direct numerical independent endpoint evaluations yielded K(0+)=2.7, K(pi/2)=1.79339386, K(pi)=1.95970210, K(3pi/2)=1.76893970. The supplied check_sector.py uses rational Machin-series enclosures proving K(pi/2),K(3pi/2)<9/5 and K(pi)>39/20; inspected code and analytic expressions. IVT gives three distinct roots for every k in (9/5,39/20), and R=sqrt(m/F2) matches both moments for every m>0. Nonidentical angles give noncongruent two-dimensional sectors; the third (>pi) is nonconvex. Numerical finite roots are illustrative, not the proof of a continuum.
